properties.description: Seven properties over the real transport, end to end against a spawned server: a request naming no design is refused AND says what would have worked; each design answers on its own prefix; a write into A is readable in A; it is ABSENT from B (the one that corrupts rather than errors); A's session id is not valid under B; an unknown id is refused by name; a path is refused exactly as an unknown id is. Written after the crate-level tests could not reach the transport, because until 2026-09-13 there was none.
properties.name: two_designs_stay_apart_over_the_transport.rs
